newsitem.title: USA: Rickel Home Centers names CEO.
newsitem.headline: Rickel Home Centers names CEO.

text.p: Rickel Home Centres Inc., the home improvement retailer now in Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection, said Tuesday it had named Joseph Nusim president and chief executive officer.
Nusim's appointment is subject to approval of the Bankruptcy Court in which Rickel's Chapter 11 case is pending.
Nusim, who will also serve as chief merchandising officer, succeeds Antonio Alvarez, who had served in this position since July when Jules Borshadel left to pursue other interests, the company said.
Nusim has served as a retail consultant to a variety of chains since 1994 when he left as head of Channel Home Centres, which was acquired by Rickel.
